review_notes: I read the whole file and compared its definitions with their neighbours. The definitions are toPowOne, headMod, powActRight, boundAssoc, powDetach, boundBridge, midConcatFstIso, midConcatSndIso, powSplit and powMergeIso. I grepped the Deligne directory for related declarations such as powAttach and midConcatFst. toPowOne, boundAssoc and powDetach are deliberate retypings of Mathlib associators and unitors, and their docstrings say so. powDetach is the stated inverse bridge to the local powAttach. midConcatFstIso and midConcatSndIso package the bridges of midConcatFst and midConcatSnd as isomorphisms for use with Iso.cancel_iso_hom_left. powMergeIso is a named package of powMulDesc and powSplit. None of these competes with a Mathlib concept. The whisker and tensorHom lemmas (whiskerRight_tensorHom and similar) look like standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. I did not check Mathlib's Mod_ or tensor-power API in depth, because the module-power and tensor definitions live in other files outside this target.
